decisions.statement: The record taken out is named by a field of that record rather than by its place.
A path the world names no page at is refused.
Taking the record out is left to the mechanical change of the same name.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
No record taken out is resolved.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one record taken out of one page property, judged by the checks a landing runs
